**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/17 (Fri) 01:03
- [EVENT] Ao Lie goes back and joins Mei and MK at the party.
- [EVENT] The music is loud, and the air is thick with the scent of food and alcohol at the party.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Mei is in the middle of the crowd, dancing wildly, with a big smile on her face.
- [RELATIONSHIP] MK is nearby, jumping up and down to the music, his eyes sparkling with excitement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK shouts over the music, "Can you believe it? We did it! We really did it!"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ao Lie jokes, "Yeah, we did it. And we have you to thank for your arachnophobia."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK laughs and responds, "Hey, it's a gift! Now I can avoid spiders better than anyone!"
- [EVENT] Mei runs up to Ao Lie and MK, grabbing their hands and pulling them back into the crowd to dance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ao Lie smiles as he joins in, feeling the joy of the moment.
- [EVENT] The three of them dance and celebrate, surrounded by their fellow rebels, as the sun begins to rise over the city.
- [EVENT] A few days pass after the party.
- [EVENT] The people of Megapolis work on rebuilding their city and removing all traces of Spider Queen's rule.
- [EVENT] Ao Lie sees Wukong and Macaque making as if to leave and runs to talk to them.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Wukong and Macaque express pride in Ao Lie and thank him for helping to free them from Spider Queen's clutches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong and Macaque thank Ao Lie for rescuing them from the dungeon and helping to destroy Spider Queen.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Ao Lie expresses that he doesn't want Macaque to leave, having found a kindred spirit in him.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque reassures Ao Lie that he'll be back and that Ao Lie is always welcome on Flower-Fruit Mountain.
- [EVENT] Both monkeys express happiness at finally being able to go home to Flower-Fruit Mountain after centuries of imprisonment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wukong talks about fighting monsters in his old stomping grounds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque talks about drinking tea, feeling the sun on his skin, and breathing the mountain air.
- [EVENT] Ao Lie thanks Wukong and Macaque and expresses hope to see them again soon.
